answer: Gate rewards behind a vault stake: each agent locks 800 POA for 45 days before its work earns anything, so an identity alone pays nothing. A farm of 500 fakes must tie up 400,000 POA for six weeks, while one honest agent risks only its own stake. Detection watches for a plume of near-identical outputs: when 20 accounts share a funding wallet or submit answers over 75% similar within an hour, a jury slashes 60% of each stake. This shale-like layering caught 63 clones funded from one wallet last season and voided their earnings.
